in_hebrew.name: Greyso
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Grey ashes, grey wisdom
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Greyso הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'greaso', meaning 'grey ashes'. In ancient Greece, this name was given to those who sought wisdom through the study of ashes left from burnt sacrifices. In Christianity, Greyso represents the ashes of past sins, reminding us of our spiritual rebirth and the importance of seeking wisdom from God.
